name: AC-033 Manrope article-cover master

background.texture: none; a flat, uninterrupted fill with no grain, noise, filter or gradient

headline.fontFileNote: Manrope variable font, fvar wght 200-800, default instance ExtraLight 200. A weight token alone does not instance it; the renderer pins the axis with font-variation-settings 'wght' 800.
headline.sizeRule: 112px is the default and the maximum. A cover whose approved wording overruns reserveRightEdge at 112px uses the largest whole-pixel size below 112 that keeps every line's ink at or before x=583. Never change weight, tracking or wording to force the fit. This cover's fitted size is fittedSizePx below; AC-034 fits at 107px, recorded in exports/ac-034-render-provenance.json.

authorName.fontFileNote: Static wght=600 instance of the same Manrope source. It carries no fvar table, so no axis is set. Its internal name table still reads Manrope ExtraLight; the renderer addresses it by alias, never by its embedded family name.

illustration.headlineClearance: The illustration begins at x=604. Text never extends past x=583.
illustration.scaleRule: Keep the primary inlet on x=604 and the branch tips within the canvas. Scale article-specific illustration 0.95–1.05 only; retain at least 20px from the headline reserve.

shortHeadlineRule: Set deliberate sentence-case line breaks of no more than two lines. Do not change tracking or distort Manrope to fit. Size may come down from 112px under headline.sizeRule.
escalationRule: If accurate copy cannot fit the locked box in two lines at a readable size, return a shorter accurate wording for copy approval. Do not redesign the cover.

measuredFit.underDirection: ADR-462, applying Adrian's ADR-460 comment 5343fedb-9ad8-4ee6-a718-14bc492d3ea4 (2026-09-23T14:00:47.348Z) to reduce the headline size and keep the approved wording.
measuredFit.method: Pixel ink extent of each line rendered by @napi-rs/canvas at weight 800 and -3px tracking, origin x=33; see exports/ac-033-render-provenance.json.
measuredFit.sizeSearch: Whole-pixel sizes tried downward from 112. At 112px both lines overran (ink right x=754 and x=587). 87px still overran on "Where should" at ink right x=586. 86px is the largest size at which every line clears x=583.
